opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together, covering arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Supports festivals, workshops, exchanges, collaborative projects, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and be supported by referees not based at the same institution as either partner.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 for multi‑year projects) can be used for travel, conference and publication costs.
